title: A NOT NULL refusal on an undeclared (drifted) column still answers differently per door: REST 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with a drift hint, dispatcher /data 500 INTERNAL_ERROR, actions 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with the driver's text
body:
Filing class: ② follow-up from a landed card's contract review. Carrier: PR #26026 (Fixes #24768), contract review comment 6412927808, boundary flag 3.

## What

#24768's ruling A translates a database NOT NULL refusal into one `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` answer for **a field the object declares**. A refusal on a column the object's field map does **not** hold (a drifted column: present in the table, absent from the metadata) is outside that ruling, and still answers three ways:

| door | answer on `main` after #26026 |
|:--|:--|
| `RestServer` `/data` POST/PATCH | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, a column sentence plus the drift `hint` (`mapDataError`'s NOT NULL arm) |
| dispatcher `/data` POST/PATCH (`HttpDispatcher.dispatch()`) | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` |
| actions door (`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts`) | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, the driver's text in `message`, its code demoted to `declaredCode` |

#24768's title ("one answer per refusal across doors") is therefore not met for the drift case.

## Direction (from the review)

The dispatcher and actions exits recognise `mapDataError`'s NOT NULL arm for an undeclared column, so all three doors answer the REST shape (`400 VALIDATION_FAILED` + drift hint). Keep the driver text out of `message` on every door (the driver-fault redaction boundary already holds this for REST).

## Acceptance

- A pin per door (dispatcher `/data` POST and PATCH, actions, REST) on a real store with a drifted NOT NULL column, `toEqual` on the whole body, red first on `main`.
- The declared-field answers #26026 pinned stay byte-identical.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` 2026-10-26, "NOT NULL refusal undeclared drifted column dispatcher 500 INTERNAL_ERROR different answer per door" → #24768 (the carrier, ruling A, declared fields only) and closed neighbours #24662 / #20701 (other classes). No open card for the drift class.
